verified: false — 7.2a is a PARTIAL roll. Only 4 of the patch's 18 documented changes are representable in the current schema (Skarner W/E cooldowns; Armorcrusher Boots attackDamage + lethality). The remaining 14 touch mechanics this schema does not model (transform-form abilities, shields, heals, ability mana costs, max-health/current-health damage, passive stat conversions) or items absent from the dataset (Tear of the Goddess, Seraph's Embrace, Muramana). See ROSTER.md "Patch 7.2a" for the itemised gap list.

Armorcrusher Boots attackDamage 25->20 and lethality 12->10 cross-confirmed against Riot patch notes + changelog.gg. Skarner cooldowns come from the Riot notes; changelog.gg's summary omits them (lists only ARAM adjustments) — primary source used per source-priority rule.
